comment: shk.c unpaid_cost() (3260-3305) reports through impossible() when the hero is in no shop or no bill holds an unpaid object ("unpaid_cost: object wasn't on any bill."); objnam.c doname() calls it for every unpaid object, so C prints the report while it formats the name, before the message that uses it. Seed 6120158's Dlvl 3 has an armor shop (72,14)-(77,18) whose keeper stands at (73,14) inside an open door at (73,13) (port-only scanSeeds() probe over 6120040-6120400 for an armor or weapon shop with an open or empty doorway, fifth hit). The debug-mode Valkyrie level-teleports there, lands on a banded mail, picks it up (unpaid), wishes for a hole under herself (objnam.c wizterrainwish()), flings the keeper out of the door with #wiztelekinesis (wizcmds.c wiz_telekinesis() -> mhurtle()), and plunges through the hole with '>'. shk.c u_left_shop() returns early because the keeper is not inhishop(), so the mail stays unpaid on Dlvl 4. She wishes for a second hole there and drops the mail. Standing on a hole she cannot reach the floor, so do.c dodrop() prints "You drop %s." (doname: report first) and hitfloor() prints "%s hits the edge of the hole." (Doname2: report first) before dokick.c ship_object(). The mail falls through, so shk.c stolen_value() reports "onbill: unpaid obj without shopkeeper?" and mkobj.c add_to_migration() reports "unpaid object migrating to another level? [banded mail]". Seed, datetime, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session and batch game.
